title: Remove Board Deletion Cross & Add Agent Right-Click Context Menu with Rename/Delete
summary: 1) Removed accidental board deletion cross button from KanbanBoard.tsx board tabs (deletion strictly kept on right-click context menu). 2) Added right-click context menu (onContextMenu) to agent cards in CortexExplorer.tsx Section 2 'Агенты' with 'Переименовать агента' (Pencil icon, RenameAgentModal) and 'Удалить агента' (Trash2 icon, red, confirmation with column assignment warning). 3) Added rename_agent_persona command in src-tauri/src/commands.rs and registered in lib.rs, which validates name, renames .cvh/agents/<old_role> to .cvh/agents/<new_role>, and synchronizes references in boards.json and pipeline.json. 4) Updated delete_agent_persona_file to reset persona references to None in boards.json and pipeline.json. 5) Added renameAgentPersona and deleteAgentPersona methods to cortexStore.ts with auto-reloading of boards and personas.
notes: Verified with cargo check, cargo clippy -- -D warnings, pnpm run build, and cargo test. Autonomously merged to main, pushed to origin main, and worktree cleaned up.
